statement:
theorem fiber_point_of_root [NeZero (2 : K)] {x t a b c : K} (hx : x ≠ 0)

    (hP : c * t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2 + b * t - 2 * a = 0) :
    F K (x, t - 1 / x, (2 * x - 3 * x ^ 2 * (t - 1 / x) - c) / x ^ 3) =

name: Alpoge.fiber_tau_coordinates
statement:
theorem fiber_tau_coordinates {x y z a b c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h : F K (x, y, z) = (a, b, c)) :
    x ≠ 0 ∧ c / x ≠ 0 ∧
      chartG₁ (a * c ^ 2) (c / x) (1 + x * y) = 0 ∧
      chartG₂ (b * c) (c / x) (1 + x * y) = 0

name: Alpoge.fiber_u_elimination
statement:
theorem fiber_u_elimination (x y z a b c : K)
    (h : F K (x, y, z) = (a, b, c)) :
    c ^ 2 * ((27 * a ^ 2 * c ^ 2 - 18 * a * b * c + 16 * a + b ^ 3 * c - b ^ 2)
        * (1 + x * y) ^ 3 + (b ^ 2 - 12 * a) * (1 + x * y) - 4 * a) = 0

name: Alpoge.fiber_xzero
statement:
theorem fiber_xzero {y z a b c : K} (h : F K (0, y, z) = (a, b, c)) :

name: Alpoge.reconstruct_czero

name: Alpoge.reconstruct_fiber

theorem reconstruct_fiber {a b c t u : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0)

name: Alpoge.residual_disc
statement:
theorem residual_disc [NeZero (2 : K)] {x y z a b c : K} (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (h : F K (x, y, z) = (a, b, c)) :
    (c * (y + 1 / x) - 2) ^ 2 -
        4 * c * (c * (y + 1 / x) ^ 2 - 2 * (y + 1 / x) + b) =
      -(wallW a b c) * x ^ 2

name: Alpoge.resolvent_injective

    (h₁ : F K (x₁, y₁, z₁) = (a, b, c)) (h₂ : F K (x₂, y₂, z₂) = (a, b, c))

name: Alpoge.resolvent_simpleRoot
statement:
theorem resolvent_simpleRoot {x y z a b c : K} (hx : x ≠ 0)

    c * (y + 1 / x) ^ 3 - 2 * (y + 1 / x) ^ 2 + b * (y + 1 / x) - 2 * a = 0 ∧
      3 * c * (y + 1 / x) ^ 2 - 4 * (y + 1 / x) + b ≠ 0

name: Alpoge.sheetCubic_sub
statement:
theorem sheetCubic_sub (A r t s : K) :
    sheetCubic A r t - sheetCubic A r s =
      (t - s) * (2 * (t ^ 2 + t * s + s ^ 2) + (3 * r - 4) * (t + s))

name: Alpoge.sheetCubic_zero
statement:
theorem sheetCubic_zero (a b c : K) :
    sheetCubic (a * c ^ 2) (b * c) 0 =
      -(c ^ 2 *
        (27 * a ^ 2 * c ^ 2 - 18 * a * b * c + 16 * a + b ^ 3 * c - b ^ 2))

name: Alpoge.simple_root_G₁
statement:
theorem simple_root_G₁ (A r t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) (hD : wallD r t ≠ 0) :
    wallD r t ^ 3 * chartG₁ A t (wallN A r t / (t * wallD r t)) =
      (27 * A + 9 * t - 4) * sheetCubic A r t

name: Alpoge.simple_root_G₂
statement:
theorem simple_root_G₂ (A r t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) (hD : wallD r t ≠ 0) :
    wallD r t ^ 2 * chartG₂ r t (wallN A r t / (t * wallD r t)) =
      9 * sheetCubic A r t

Alpoge.third_simpleRoot
statement:
theorem third_simpleRoot {a b c t₁ t₂ : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hne : t₁ ≠ t₂)
    (h₁ : c * t₁ ^ 3 - 2 * t₁ ^ 2 + b * t₁ - 2 * a = 0 ∧
      3 * c * t₁ ^ 2 - 4 * t₁ + b ≠ 0)
    (h₂ : c * t₂ ^ 3 - 2 * t₂ ^ 2 + b * t₂ - 2 * a = 0 ∧
      3 * c * t₂ ^ 2 - 4 * t₂ + b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t₃ : K,
      (c * t₃ ^ 3 - 2 * t₃ ^ 2 + b * t₃ - 2 * a = 0 ∧

statement:

name: Alpoge.neg_four_mul_wallW_eq_sq_sep

theorem neg_four_mul_wallW_eq_sq_sep {a b c t₁ t₂ t₃ : K}

theorem card_excluded (t : K) :

name: Alpoge.card_incidencePairs_eq

name: Alpoge.card_simpleRootFinset_mem

name: Alpoge.exists_target_of_three_roots
statement:
theorem exists_target_of_three_roots [NeZero (2 : K)] {t₁ t₂ t₃ : K}
    (h12 : t₁ ≠ t₂) (h13 : t₁ ≠ t₃) (h23 : t₂ ≠ t₃)
    (hs : t₁ + t₂ + t₃ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a b c : K,
      projectiveSimpleRoot a b c (some t₁) ∧
      projectiveSimpleRoot a b c (some t₂) ∧

name: Alpoge.exists_target_of_two_roots_and_inf
statement:
theorem exists_target_of_two_roots_and_inf [NeZero (2 : K)] {t₁ t₂ : K}
    (h12 : t₁ ≠ t₂) :
    ∃ a b : K,
      projectiveSimpleRoot a b (0 : K) none ∧
      projectiveSimpleRoot a b (0 : K) (some t₁) ∧

name: Alpoge.fiber_filter_card
statement:
theorem fiber_filter_card (v : K × K × K) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : K × K × K => F K p = v).card =
      (simpleRootFinset v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2).card

name: Alpoge.finiteField_fiber_statistics
statement:
theorem finiteField_fiber_statistics :
    (6 * targetCount (K := K) 3 =
      if (3 : K) = 0
      then Fintype.card K ^ 2 * (Fintype.card K - 1)
      else (Fintype.card K - 1) * (Fintype.card K ^ 2 + 2)) ∧
    targetCount (K := K) 1 + 3 * targetCount (K := K) 3 =
      Fintype.card K ^ 3 ∧
    targetCount (K := K) 0 + targetCount (K := K) 1 +
      targetCount (K := K) 3 = Fintype.card K ^ 3 ∧
    targetCount (K := K) 0 = 2 * targetCount (K := K) 3

name: Alpoge.mem_simpleRootFinset
statement:
theorem mem_simpleRootFinset {a b c : K} {r : Option K} :
    r ∈ simpleRootFinset a b c ↔ projectiveSimpleRoot a b c r

name: Alpoge.ncard_fiber_eq_card_simpleRoots
statement:
theorem ncard_fiber_eq_card_simpleRoots (a b c : K) :
    Set.ncard {p : K × K × K | F K p = (a, b, c)} =
      (simpleRootFinset a b c).card

name: Alpoge.pair_filter_eq_compl
statement:
theorem pair_filter_eq_compl (t : K) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun y : K =>
        y ≠ t ∧ 2 * t + y ≠ 0 ∧ t + 2 * y ≠ 0) =
      ({t, -2 * t, -(2⁻¹) * t} : Finset K)ᶜ

name: Alpoge.six_mul_targetCount_three
statement:
theorem six_mul_targetCount_three :
    6 * targetCount (K := K) 3 =
      if (3 : K) = 0
      then Fintype.card K ^ 2 * (Fintype.card K - 1)
      else (Fintype.card K - 1) * (Fintype.card K ^ 2 + 2)

name: Alpoge.sum_fiber_filter_cards
statement:
theorem sum_fiber_filter_cards :
    ∑ v : K × K × K,
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : K × K × K => F K p = v).card =
      Fintype.card K ^ 3

name: Alpoge.sum_ne_zero_of_three_roots
statement:
theorem sum_ne_zero_of_three_roots [NeZero (2 : K)] {a b c t₁ t₂ t₃ : K}
    (h12 : t₁ ≠ t₂) (h13 : t₁ ≠ t₃) (h23 : t₂ ≠ t₃)
    (H1 : c * t₁ ^ 3 - 2 * t₁ ^ 2 + b * t₁ - 2 * a = 0)
    (H2 : c * t₂ ^ 3 - 2 * t₂ ^ 2 + b * t₂ - 2 * a = 0)
    (H3 : c * t₃ ^ 3 - 2 * t₃ ^ 2 + b * t₃ - 2 * a = 0) :
    t₁ + t₂ + t₃ ≠ 0

name: Alpoge.target_unique_of_three_roots
statement:
theorem target_unique_of_three_roots [NeZero (2 : K)]
    {a b c a' b' c' t₁ t₂ t₃ : K}
    (h12 : t₁ ≠ t₂) (h13 : t₁ ≠ t₃) (h23 : t₂ ≠ t₃)
    (H1 : c * t₁ ^ 3 - 2 * t₁ ^ 2 + b * t₁ - 2 * a = 0)
    (H2 : c * t₂ ^ 3 - 2 * t₂ ^ 2 + b * t₂ - 2 * a = 0)
    (H3 : c * t₃ ^ 3 - 2 * t₃ ^ 2 + b * t₃ - 2 * a = 0)
    (H1' : c' * t₁ ^ 3 - 2 * t₁ ^ 2 + b' * t₁ - 2 * a' = 0)
    (H2' : c' * t₂ ^ 3 - 2 * t₂ ^ 2 + b' * t₂ - 2 * a' = 0)
    (H3' : c' * t₃ ^ 3 - 2 * t₃ ^ 2 + b' * t₃ - 2 * a' = 0) :
    a = a' ∧ b = b' ∧ c = c'

name: Alpoge.target_unique_of_two_roots_and_inf
statement:
theorem target_unique_of_two_roots_and_inf [NeZero (2 : K)]
    {a b a' b' t₁ t₂ : K} (h12 : t₁ ≠ t₂)
    (H1 : -2 * t₁ ^ 2 + b * t₁ - 2 * a = 0)
    (H2 : -2 * t₂ ^ 2 + b * t₂ - 2 * a = 0)
    (H1' : -2 * t₁ ^ 2 + b' * t₁ - 2 * a' = 0)
    (H2' : -2 * t₂ ^ 2 + b' * t₂ - 2 * a' = 0) :
    a = a' ∧ b = b'

name: Alpoge.vieta_of_three_roots
statement:
theorem vieta_of_three_roots {a b c t₁ t₂ t₃ : K}
    (h12 : t₁ ≠ t₂) (h13 : t₁ ≠ t₃) (h23 : t₂ ≠ t₃)
    (H1 : c * t₁ ^ 3 - 2 * t₁ ^ 2 + b * t₁ - 2 * a = 0)
    (H2 : c * t₂ ^ 3 - 2 * t₂ ^ 2 + b * t₂ - 2 * a = 0)
    (H3 : c * t₃ ^ 3 - 2 * t₃ ^ 2 + b * t₃ - 2 * a = 0) :
    c * (t₁ + t₂ + t₃) = 2 ∧
      c * (t₁ * t₂ + t₁ * t₃ + t₂ * t₃) = b ∧
      c * (t₁ * t₂ * t₃) = 2 * a

name: Alpoge.FormalConjecturesJC.jacobian_conjecture_false
statement:
theorem jacobian_conjecture_false :
    ¬ ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [CharZero k] (σ : Type) [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ]
        (F : RegularFunction k σ σ), IsUnit (Jacobian F).det →
        ∃ G : RegularFunction k σ σ,
          comp G F = FormalConjecturesJC.id k σ ∧
          comp F G = FormalConjecturesJC.id k σ

name: Alpoge.S3_cycle_index
statement:
theorem S3_cycle_index {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (t : R) :
    (1 - t) ^ 3 + 3 * ((1 - t) * (1 - t ^ 2)) + 2 * (1 - t ^ 3) =
      6 * (1 - t)

name: Alpoge.fiberCount_sign_bias
statement:
theorem fiberCount_sign_bias :
    2 * (targetCount (K := K) 1 : ℤ) =
      (Fintype.card K : ℤ) ^ 3 +
        ((Fintype.card K : ℤ) ^ 3 - 6 * (targetCount (K := K) 3 : ℤ)) ∧
    3 * (targetCount (K := K) 0 : ℤ) =
      (Fintype.card K : ℤ) ^ 3 -
        ((Fintype.card K : ℤ) ^ 3 - 6 * (targetCount (K := K) 3 : ℤ))

name: Alpoge.sum_permCharPoly_fiber
statement:
theorem sum_permCharPoly_fiber {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (t : R) :
    ∑ v : K × K × K, permCharPoly R (fiberCount v) t =
      (1 - t) * ((Fintype.card K : R) ^ 3 * (1 - t ^ 2) +
        6 * (targetCount (K := K) 3 : R) * t ^ 2)

name: Alpoge.sum_permCharPoly_fiber_of_three_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sum_permCharPoly_fiber_of_three_ne_zero (h3 : (3 : K) ≠ 0)
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (t : R) :
    ∑ v : K × K × K, permCharPoly R (fiberCount v) t =
      (1 - t) * ((Fintype.card K : R) ^ 3 * (1 - t ^ 2) +
        ((Fintype.card K : R) - 1) * ((Fintype.card K : R) ^ 2 + 2) * t ^ 2)

name: Alpoge.res_eq_key_combination
statement:
theorem res_eq_key_combination (a b c d e : K) :
    a ^ 2 * e - a * b * d + c * b ^ 2 =
      b * (a * d + b * c) + a * (a * e - 2 * b * d)
